positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a senior development engineer in Retail Systems, building a massive data analytics platform designed to help our business identify and capitalize on margin opportunities. The platform is used by several thousand internal users and also serves data on one of Amazon's vendor portals.

· Re-architected the core of our application into discrete SOA components. By introducing web service boundaries we alleviated scaling and maintainability constraints in the pervious, monolithic architecture. 
· Designed and implemented a distributed transaction manager based on the Paxos algo in order to increase horizontal scalability 
· Multi-threaded our application's data access layer creating a distributed query paradigm much like Apache Drill, yielding a 20% performance improvement.
· Improved measurability and stability of our platform's performance by building an automated load test suite that integrated with our continuous integration / deployment system. This initiative improved the transaction rate (TPS) of our application by 50%.
· Provided code and design reviews for my team as well as adjacent teams.
· Mentored junior developers as part of the Amazon Mentorship Program.
· Led my project team's Sprint planning and Scrums.
· Conducted 'Brown Bag' sessions for several teams on topics ranging from "Dependency Injection" and "Securing your web service" to "Building Robots with Microcontrollers".


This position required the use of the following technologies: 
· Amazon Web Services - EC2, Elastic Data Pipeline, Elastic MapReduce S3, SimpleDB, SimpleNotificationService (SNS / SQS), ElastiCache, Relational Database Service (RDS)
· Java, GWT, Hive, Hadoop, Spring, Java Concurrency

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description:
Global Head of Systems Management

· Designed and implemented a globally used Capacity and Performance management
platform using Java w/Spring for both the backend and presentation layer. The web tier incorporate traditional MVC patterns. The system tracks hundreds of KPIs across thousands of entities on a near realtime basis.
· Personally designed and implemented a data federation layer to provide custom real time event correlation and act as an integration point between all the firms monitoring systems. The platform was built on JMS and utilized Apache ActiveMQ for message brokering with a series of ‘bridges’ written in Java to provide contextual translation between event domains.
· Set the global monitoring and event management strategy for the firm including the global rollout of System Sentinel to 14,000 servers.
· Managed a team of 7 people, with day to day responsibilities including the maintenance and enhancement of our primary monitoring platforms (HPOV & System Sentinel), our ticketing system (Remedy), as well as our asset management solution (CMDB w/ADDM).
· Provided recommendations and best practices to application teams on how to address performance and operational issues.

· Implemented high performance monitoring tools in C++ using TibcoRV to monitor Equities Orderflow for latency and Order Status.

positions.title: Production Support Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented a real-time monitoring platform for wombat in C++ leveraging the 3.3/4.0 Mama APIs to consume administrative symbols via record subscriptions.
•	Designed and implemented a C++ application to consume raw exchange multicast market data feeds for sequence number, latency, and data quality inspection in real-time for UTP, CTA, ArcaBook, TvItch 3.1, Openbook, NyseBQ, and Opra.
•	Improved the Wombat infrastructure from 100ms internal latency down to < 1ms relative to line time using quantitative analysis of the data produced by the above tools.
•	Managed every aspect of our LBM based Wombat Feedhandlers including: kernel tuning, hardware selection, network capacity, client side tuning and troubleshooting. Feeds included UTP, CTA, ArcaBook, TvItch 3.1, Openbook, NyseBQ across a standard mixture of Production, DR, and QA environments.
•	Maintained and extended a Java based log file monitoring tool used on all production servers.
•	Responsible for application support for the Pipeline Exchange including: FIX Order Flow, Matching Engine, Algorithmic Trading Performance, and general Linux issues.

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
•	Extensive hands-on experience in design, implementation and support of multi-platform applications for servicing varying problem domains including Biometric Authentication, E-Bonding, Proactive Monitoring via Synthetic transactions, Intelligent IP Telephony Call Routing based on call center load factors, and Near Real Time Data Aggregation 
•	Designed and implemented a globally deployed secure RPC service for the firm’s Windows platforms. Patent Pending.
•	Managed a team of several developers through various automation and scripting projects that supported the Network and Extranet Operations teams.
•	Created E-Bonding solutions for integrations with Verizon and BT Radianz
•	Built a voice biometric telephony application to allow account management for a number of the firm’s internal applications (Active directory, Mainframe, etc…)

projects.title: Athena Query Federation
projects.description:
https://github.com/awslabs/aws-athena-query-federation

The Amazon Athena Query Federation SDK allows you to customize Amazon Athena with your own code. This enables you to integrate with new data sources, proprietary data formats, or build in new user defined functions. Initially these customizations will be limited to the parts of a query that occur during a TableScan operation but will eventually be expanded to include other parts of the query lifecycle using the same easy to understand interface.

projects.title: Autonomous Rover using GPU Accelerated SLAM (Simultaneous Localization And Mapping)
projects.description: A basic autonomous rover built on ROS Indigo and using Seeduino's Hercules base with LIDAR for mapping and an Nvidia Tegra TX1 for higher level robot functions. The project has three main components: the hardware platform, fully autonomous navigation using ROS' navigation stack, and a simplistic 'exploration' mode I wrote that enabled the rover to explorer its surroundings in order to generate a complete map. With GPUs being increasingly useful for accelerated computationally intensive workloads, I undertook this project as a way to learn CUDA and OpenCV so that I could apply GPU optimizations in my day to day work.
